record.question: Which of the following does not constitute an anomaly for stepping up of pay of senior on drawing less pay than his junior?
options: both the junior and the senior Government servants should belong to the same cadre and the posts in which they have been promoted are identical in the same cadre.
the Level in the Pay Matrix of the lower and higher posts in which they are entitled to draw pay should be identical
where a junior gets more pay by virtue of any advance increments granted to him.
the anomaly is directly as a result of the application of the provisions of Fundamental Rule 22(I)(a)(1)
